landing.title: Study smarter with AI.
landing.subtitle: Upload your course PDFs and get auto-generated flashcards & interactive quizzes for active recall.
landing.heroSubtitle: Turn your PDF course materials into flashcards and quizzes — instantly.
landing.mockupDrop: Drag your PDF here, or browse
landing.mockupHint: Supports lecture slides, e-books, and PDF notes (max 15 MB)
landing.aboutTitle:
Stop passive reading.
Start active learning.
landing.aboutDesc: Yoohoo uses AI to extract key concepts from your lecture PDFs and transforms them into interactive flashcards and practice quizzes — so you can study smarter, not harder.
landing.feature1Desc: Drop any course PDF — slides, e-books, or notes. Our AI reads it and pulls out the most important concepts automatically.
landing.feature2Desc: Review key terms and definitions one by one with interactive flip cards. Perfect for memorization and active recall.
landing.feature3Desc: Test your understanding with AI-generated multiple choice questions. Get instant feedback and track your progress over time.
landing.feature4Desc: All your materials and quiz scores are saved. Revisit flashcards or retake quizzes anytime to reinforce your learning.
